user_pain_radar.title: 编程任务对应的额度、重置周期与续费选择
user_pain_radar.pain: 已复核两条原始讨论正文：编程任务的工具分配和配额消耗可预测性存在困惑；显示的相对时间不足以确认绝对发布日期。
user_pain_radar.task: 核对现有选型页的新旧订阅分组、额度单位与重置规则；先确认官方方案适用人群，再补具体事实缺口。
acceptance: 保留来源日期、单位与周期；未知值不能写成零或无限。
同一帖子重复缓存只计一个来源；免费意图不当作付费需求。
先复现现有路径缺口，再决定最小改动；沿用现有完成/导出计量。
user_pain_radar.commercial_hypothesis: 帮助正在续费或迁移的开发者完成具体工具决策；本轮没有 BPJ 付款证据。
user_pain_radar.counter_evidence: 原帖回复有相反体验；现有 BPJ 选型器已覆盖多数决策。官方方案可能区分新旧订阅，不能把旧套餐一律判错或批量覆盖。

user_pain_radar.title: AI 结论缺少业务背景与来源支撑
user_pain_radar.pain: 公开讨论反映 AI 对缺少上下文的问题给出肯定解释；与 Jarvis 的来源检查有相邻适配，尚未证明是本站用户需求。
user_pain_radar.task: 用合成任务复核现有 Jarvis 的证据与不确定性输出；先确认是否存在可复现缺口。
acceptance: 保留业务前提、来源日期和未知项；引用格式通过不等于结论被证明。
用冻结的合成任务比较改前改后；不读取客户任务正文。
不改变电商周报导师的单一受众，不增加模型额度或收费承诺。
user_pain_radar.commercial_hypothesis: 提高已有研究任务的可复核性与复用价值；付费意愿未知。
user_pain_radar.counter_evidence: 来源为代理商报告语境，与 AGI 使用者适配需要单独验证；一个帖子不是普遍需求。

user_pain_radar.title: 试用、取消与续费条件核对
user_pain_radar.pain: 订阅前的试用能力和退出条件不清楚；目前仅有日期未知的缓存线索。
user_pain_radar.task: 核验官方试用、退款和取消规则，与现有 BPJ 数据字段比对后决定是否补齐。
acceptance: 只使用厂商当日官方条款；区分免费层、试用与退款。
不得承诺没有官方保证的退款或精确剩余额度。
保留现有匿名选型入口，不新增付费墙或支付方案。
user_pain_radar.commercial_hypothesis: 缩短已有 AI 工具选型流程；联盟资格和收入另行核验。
user_pain_radar.counter_evidence: 可能只需要链接官方帮助页，不需要新工具。

user_pain_radar.title: 通用 AI 客户报告生成暂不扩建
user_pain_radar.pain: 报告整理费时，但通用生成、摘要与定时发送已有成熟替代。
user_pain_radar.task: 仅保存反证；不建立新的代理商报告站或改变现有导师定位。
acceptance: 重新投入需同类买家重复缺口、明确现有替代失效与可交付结果。
user_pain_radar.commercial_hypothesis: 报告收尾与核对仍是假设，本轮不售卖。
user_pain_radar.counter_evidence: Swydo、AgencyAnalytics 与 Whatagraph 已覆盖通用 AI 报告；存在满意用户反证。

getecoback.buyer: German-speaking households deciding whether and what to buy for a specific room or maintenance task
getecoback.job: Check the cause and home constraints, compare exact sourced models, then decide whether a purchase is justified.
getecoback.free_value: Source-linked household guides, a multi-category exact-model catalog, useful category-specific local tools and no-purchase outcomes.
getecoback.existing_revenue: Disclosed, confirmed DE/US affiliate destinations; commission requires merchant order and refund reconciliation.
getecoback.acquisition: Prioritize relevant arrivals to concrete buying questions and exact model/variant comparisons; maintain functioning cooling entries alongside seasonal household paths and the bounded owned-channel pilot.
getecoback.next_action: Expand distinct household product categories, source-checked models and appropriate category tools as explicitly requested by the owner. Retain the separate 200 voluntary affiliate_click events/day goal, accurate destination labels, source expiry and existing publication windows; never count unverified candidates or duplicate colors as product growth.
getecoback.expansion_gate: An uncovered buyer question with a reachable channel, exact model/market sources, useful original value and maintenance capacity; follow the existing category and daily-page rules.
getecoback.revenue_evidence: Attributed eligible merchant orders, commission after reversals, settlement and costs; site clicks are separate.

baipiaoji.buyer: Readers selecting an AI tool; separately, tool vendors buying a clearly labelled category placement
baipiaoji.job: Match a task to actual access, limits and purchase terms; let vendors assess a separate sponsorship offer.
baipiaoji.free_value: Tool selection and local task utilities remain available without a paid membership.
baipiaoji.existing_revenue: Existing vendor sponsorship and optional cloud workspace; commissions only for verified approved partner configurations.
baipiaoji.acquisition: Intent-matched tool/category entries, discoverable task tools and the existing table-review launch pilot.
baipiaoji.next_action: Review category-entry and voluntary-order evidence separately; acquire relevant own-task use before expanding cloud features.
baipiaoji.expansion_gate: A repeat task from the same buyer, a documented gap versus free alternatives, usable delivery and a reachable distribution path.
baipiaoji.revenue_evidence: Verified sponsorship/member payment, correct entitlement, delivery, refunds and cost; directory outbound actions are not commission.

agiscorecard.buyer: Readers following auditable AGI claims and researchers revisiting source-backed AI infrastructure theses
agiscorecard.job: Separate dated evidence from a hypothesis, record a review condition and revisit it after a relevant disclosure.
agiscorecard.free_value: The prediction ledger, public sources, local research, checks and exports remain free.
agiscorecard.existing_revenue: Existing optional cross-device member storage; other historic monetization paths require their own current partner and payment evidence.
agiscorecard.acquisition: Maintain the earned research/ledger identity; reuse the bounded thesis demonstration and public company links in requested exports.
agiscorecard.next_action: Review public-company referrals and own checks from requested exports, preserving clean links and the earned ledger identity.
agiscorecard.expansion_gate: Observed own-rule use, later reviewed checks and an explicit cross-device need before more data products, models or alert services.
agiscorecard.revenue_evidence: Attributed paid receipts and delivered saved-record use; exports, rechecks and member intent are separate.

thedollscout.buyer: US/DE collectible owners and swap-event participants organizing a collection or checking a relevant purchase
thedollscout.job: Know what is owned or wanted, prepare a collection/swap task, then compare official or accurately labelled merchant options.
thedollscout.free_value: Sourced series information, local collection tools, printable preparation and reusable blank materials.
thedollscout.existing_revenue: Disclosed eligible US/DE affiliate transactions; existing optional workspace remains independent of free collector tools.
thedollscout.acquisition: Series/task search entries and reusable collector materials; retain existing publication receipts and country-specific buying paths.
thedollscout.next_action: Assess collection completions, usable shared materials and relevant shopping actions separately before adding categories or membership features.
thedollscout.expansion_gate: A verified brand/series or repeated collector task, official source coverage and a relevant discovery path; no unsupported rarity, valuation or authenticity claims.
thedollscout.revenue_evidence: Attributed merchant orders and settled commission after refunds/costs; wish lists and shopping intent are not purchases.
